title: Arrival Of S.A. Funtikoff, Soviet Citizen

page_data.en:
Form No. 32
S.P. 25,000-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
FORNS. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 05503.
SECTION 2. March.
Date 27 / 11 / 33
Date November 29, 1933

Subject (in full) Arrival of S.A.Funtikoff Soviet citizen.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev, Forwarded by [签名]

Simon Andreievitch Funtikoff, 32, Soviet citizen, report-
ted to be an employee ( tea expert ) of the local branch of the
Centrosojus, No 2 Peking Road, arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock
on November 24, 1933, in the s.s. "Dah Loh". He holds passport
No 167753 issued on September 14, 1933, at Moscow which bears a visa
issued by the Chinese Legation at that city on September 26, 1933.
Funtikoff is accompanied by his wife, Mrs T.P. Fun-
tikoff, and their daughter aged 5 years. They are at present re-
siding at the Plaza Hotel.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Copy sent to Mr. S.
[签名]
（印：O.M.C.S.P.）
